profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Aurora
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer who's shipped mapping and geospatial products to 2+ billion monthly users. 15 years at Google, 14 at Microsoft, 4 U.S. patents.

- Gmail CI/CD. Used AI agents to overhaul Gmail's continuous integration stack, boosting release velocity 63%.

- Built an observability system (mutation tracing + visual diffing with impact-weighted sampling) for a large-scale map-data pipeline, eliminating manual QA as a release bottleneck and doubling release velocity.

- Road details (bit.ly/4fHcCsN). Cut road data generation from days to hours. Led 4 engineers adding lane-level detail globally.

- Traffic lights (bit.ly/4ysp9I3). Shipped global traffic light visualization, reducing missed turns for hundreds of millions of drivers.

- COVID layer (bit.ly/44Ei5KR). Built the C++ backend and JS frontend delivering county-level disease trends to billions of users. Led 3 engineers on iOS/Android adaptation.

- Bing Maps/Virtual Earth (Microsoft). Improved page load times to deliver maps faster than Google.  Rebuilt frontend in C# transpiled to Javascript, moving error detection from run time to compile time. 

Specialties: Geospatial systems at scale · Mobile platforms · Distributed systems · Technical leadership · C/C++, Java, JavaScript

positions.description:
•	Virtual Earth User Experience Team: Developer for AJAX-based “shell” of Microsoft’s Windows Live Local Search (aka Virtual Earth). 

Work on both the server side (ASP.NET/C#) and client side (DHTML + CSS + JScript) on full end-to-end scenarios.   Specific focus on website performance and architectural reusability.

Lead team of ten developers, in addition to personal contribution to large percentage of the codebase.

Represented Microsoft as a speaker at the 2007 Ajax Experience Conference.

positions.title: Senior Development Lead
positions.description:
•	Mobile Experience Applications Team: Developer for Microsoft’s new line of mobile-centric consumer-oriented products.  

Designed and implemented core UI features including a simple method for creating interfaces that are adaptive to multiple screen resolutions and orientations.  

Took leadership role in generation and implementation of new product ideas, including ground-breaking “Mobile AJAX” platform.  Lead team in new efforts to move applications further into cross-platform mobile reach, including personally programming our J2ME applications.

Lead team of eight developers, in addition to personal contribution to a large percentage of the codebase.

patents.title: Maintaining database transaction priority between web pages in the absence of direct communication between the pages
patents.description: Systems and methods for managing database transactions communicated from a browser-based software application to a database by a database management system in order to avoid or ameliorate transaction latency. According to one embodiment, the system or method comprises foreground and background processes, each generating database transactions. The foreground processes can submit an unlimited number of transactions to the database while background processes can only submit a limited, predetermined number of transactions to the database. To accomplish this, the background processes are associated with an in-memory queue of transactions that are then submitted to the database in a quantity no greater than the predetermined number. As a result, the database transactions sent by the foreground process will not have to wait behind more than the predetermined number of background transactions, thereby resulting in lower latency and avoiding or ameliorating delays to the user.
